privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: At FynPad ('we', 'our', 'the app') we care about your privacy. This policy explains how your personal data is collected, used and protected when you use the FynPad mobile app.

collected.title: 1. Data We Collect
collected.body: Your email address, for account verification and sign-in. The financial records you add (income, expense, category, date, amount, note). Your device language and theme preference. The budget limits and subscription details you define in the app. Your biometric data or PIN code is stored locally on your device — it is NOT sent to our servers.

purpose.title: 2. How We Use Data
purpose.body: To manage your account, store and display your financial records, and provide analytics and budget comparisons. We do NOT use your data for marketing or third-party advertising.

thirdParty.title: 3. Third-Party Processors
thirdParty.body: Database and authentication: Supabase Inc. (USA). Email delivery: Resend via Supabase (sign-up confirmation, password reset). These providers act as data processors and are subject to their own privacy policies.

rights.title: 4. Your Rights
rights.body: You can delete your account and permanently remove all your data from within the app (Settings → Account → Delete Account). This action is irreversible. You can export your data as CSV or PDF (Settings → Export Data).

security.title: 5. Security
security.body: All data transfer is encrypted over HTTPS. Your password is stored hashed. Your device lock (PIN) never leaves your device.

retention.title: 6. Data Retention
retention.body: Your data is kept for as long as your account is active. When you delete your account, all your financial records are permanently and immediately deleted.

changes.title: 7. Policy Changes
changes.body: We may update this policy from time to time. We will notify you of significant changes via an in-app notice.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: By using FynPad you agree to the following terms.

use.title: 1. Use of the Service
use.body: FynPad is designed for personal finance tracking. You may use it only through your own account and with your own financial data. You agree not to use the service unlawfully or in a way that harms others.

account.title: 2. Account Responsibility
account.body: You are responsible for the security of your account. Do not share your password or device lock PIN with anyone. If you suspect unauthorized access, change your password immediately.

data.title: 3. Data and Content
data.body: The financial data you add belongs to you. FynPad does not use this data other than to provide you the service. When you delete your account, all your data is permanently deleted.

warranty.title: 4. Disclaimer
warranty.body: FynPad does NOT provide financial advice. The analyses and insights provided are for informational purposes. You are solely responsible for your financial decisions. The service is provided 'as is' — it is not guaranteed to be uninterrupted or error-free.

termination.title: 5. Account Closure
termination.body: You can delete your account at any time from within the app. We may suspend or close accounts that violate these terms without notice.

changes.title: 6. Changes to Terms
changes.body: We may update these terms from time to time. We will inform you of significant changes.

governing.title: 7. Governing Law
governing.body: These terms are governed by the laws of the Republic of Türkiye. Disputes will be resolved in the Istanbul Courts.
